restores: `WritableFill::publish` no longer refuses a ready fill's publication on a lost volume, and the put service no longer records the loss from a `Lost` refusal.

miss_cause.evidence: Every traced run of six profiles, the five expected and `cluster-long`, reaches the planted `is_lost` check of `WritableFill::publish` (a scratch trace before it panicked in all 125,163 upload, 124,964 faulted, 125,499 cluster-broad, 126,220 cluster-pressure, 113,104 cluster-swarm and 493,086 cluster-long runs on the code of commit c6a14e9f1), and a trace inside the refusal the plant removes fired in none of 261,651 runs of the five other than cluster-long and none of 2,051,103 runs of all 21 live profiles with their controls and histories on that code, so no run publishes a fill on a lost volume; `cluster-long` stays out of `expected`, although each of its traced runs reaches the planted check, because the profile has no passing run at the default counts.
